subtitle: Light data pull: 8 quarters of revenue, operating profit and net profit (no narrative report)
limitations: Operating income for earlier quarters is the aggregator's figure and may be defined differently from the 8-K (2026-Q2: 1,538m vs 1,459m), so the operating-profit trend has a basis break at the last point.
Net profit follows the aggregator (2026-Q2: 1,287m vs 1,305m attributable in the 8-K).
Light data pull only: no valuation, no opinion, no fact-check pass, no DART/SEC body or notes review beyond what is listed under sources.

Q2 2026 revenue (48,026m) matches the SEC 8-K. The 8-K shows operating income 1,459m versus 1,538m in the aggregator, and net income attributable to stockholders 1,305m versus 1,287m; the 8-K operating income is used for 2026-Q2.

summary.text: General Motors reported 2026-Q2 revenue of USD 48.0bn and operating profit of USD 1.5bn (margin 3.0%). Q2 2026 revenue (48,026m) matches the SEC 8-K. The 8-K shows operating income 1,459m versus 1,538m in the aggregator, and net income attributable to stockholders 1,305m versus 1,287m; the 8-K operating income is used for 2026-Q2.
